steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Grease and flour two 8X4-inch loaf pans.
Beat eggs in a large bowl until light and foamy. Mix in shredded zucchini, sugar, oil, and vanilla until thoroughly combined.
Whisk flour, cocoa powder, salt, baking soda, and baking powder together in a separate bowl; stir into zucchini mixture. Mix in nuts and chocolate chips. Pour batter into the prepared loaf pans.

Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into the center of loaves comes out clean, about 1 hour. Let loaves sit in the pans for 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool completely.

raw_recipe.headline: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Bread
raw_recipe.description: This moist chocolate chip zucchini bread is packed with shredded zucchini and has gooey chocolate chips in every bite for a delicious summer treat.
raw_recipe.name: Chocolate Chip Zucchini Bread

review.reviewBody: I cut the flour back to 2 1/2 cups and added an additional 1/2 cup of cocoa powder to make up the difference. I also increased the baking powder to a full teaspoon and used pecans instead of walnuts. I made muffins out of this recipe, I was able to get 18 muffins. I did bake them at 350 for just about 22 minutes. This recipe turned out moist and delicious--I'm really glad I thought to increase the cocoa powder. My kids both thought it needs more chocolate chips. I think I could get away with cutting back the sugar by half next time and increasing the chocolate chips, maybe use mini-chocolate chips.

Awesome recipe! Nice crust, very moist inside. Great taste and texture! I added an extra 1/2 cup of chocolate chips and left out nuts. Baked in large countertop air fryer/toaster oven - started on convection for 10 minutes then turned down to about 305°, baking done at 50 minutes
Great recipe. I made it VEGAN by replacing eggs with 3/4c applesauce and 11/2t baking powder. Also I made the batter into muffins.

I loved this bread! I made a couple of changes though: I decreased the flour to 2 1/2 cups and increased the cocoa to a 1/2 cup (as suggested by another reviewer), used a 1/2 cup of oil and a 1/2 cup of applesauce, only used 1 cup of sugar, and increased the chocolate chips (I used mini ones) to 1 cup. Due to only using half the suggested sugar, the bread tasted perfectly like quickbread, not cake as mentioned in other reviews, but the chocolate chips gave it enough sweetness that even my pickiest eater kid loved it. Great way to hide veggies! Can't wait to make it again
I followed the suggestions of others and used 1/2 cups oil, 1/2 cups applesauce. Very moist and we loved it. Great way to use a vegetable. Will make this again.
This was an easy recipe to follow. I actually substituted unsweetened applesauce for 1/2 cup of oil. I can see that the cake is very moist.

This was the best bread I've made. My family loved it. I did use a cup extra of zucchini only because I didn't want to throw it away. It was so moist. I'm waiting for more zucchini to grow so I can make it again.

I doubt it made much difference but I only had canola oil. I also decided to make them muffins instead of bread, and they made 24 good size muffins. Baking time was only 30 minutes too. They're quite good. Next time I might use more choc. chips.

Enjoyed this very much, substituted 1/2 cup of Oil and 1/2 cup of Applesauce to cut down on the oil and greasy consistency as mentioned in the other review...Made one loaf for home and one for my girlfriend to take to work...everyone's loved it. One thing I've noticed is the Chocolate chips and nuts take on the flavor of the Zucchini more so than the actual bread does. It's almost like eating Coco Puffs...but it's pretty epic...I'll be making this again when fresh pumpkin is out of season :D

I cut the flour to 2 1/2 cups, increased cocoa to 1/2 cup, used 1/3 cup oil & added 2- single serving containers of applesauce. It is absolutely delicious & moist, will definitely make it this way again!!

This bread turned out just great--yummy and chocolatey. To the reviewers who complained that the bread was dry: my guess is that you used larger bread pans than the suggested 8 x 4". All my pans were 9 x 5". I decreased the baking time to 45-50 minutes, instead of the recommended one hour and they came out moist and perfect.
I substitute light sour cream for oil. It’s sooo good. My family begs me to make it all the time!
I made it without walnuts and increased the chocolate chips to one cup.
Made it as written, with a few changes. I did not have nuts, substituted the same amount of choc. Chips. Also, used 1 cup white sugar, 1 cup brown. Family loved it!
I followed the recipe, and it turned out great. I baked it in my small air fryer, baking. , and broiling oven. Can hardly wait until the daughter comes home to try it.
Was the best ever simple receipe
I made all summer and got great review and orders for more.

Made this and if it’s too dry, your zucchini might be a little too dry. Try a little applesauce or bananas until it’s moist. I put bananas, cherries, chocolate chips, zucchini and pistachios. It was the best zucchini bread I ever made. 😋
